title: The Final Sanctum
intro: The walls pulse like something alive. A heart beats under the floor. Whatever lives here will not let you leave easily, and the Heart Vault is the last lock before the final door.

objects.label: Screaming Wall
objects.reward_text: A face pushes out of the wall and screams.

objects.label: Whispering Torch
objects.reward_text: The spirit is amused. It whispers: 'Everything in this room is connected. Finish what you started.'

a_stone: Start with the biggest group size (5) and list the numbers that leave the right remainder.
Check each of those numbers against the other conditions.
The answer is 59. The vault's character number 1 is 8.
b_throne: First count ALL different arrangements of the tiles. Repeated letters divide the count.
There are 2520 different arrangements in total.
Count the arrangements that break the rule, then subtract (or count the good ones directly).
The answer is 1800. The vault's character number 2 is 6.
c_altar: Look up P and Q in your clue notes.
List the numbers above 60 that leave remainder 4 when divided by P.
Check each of them against the second condition (remainder 2 when divided by Q).
The answer is 74. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are P and N.
dare_torch: A dare is optional and never needed to leave the floor.
It never costs you anything to skip it.
Do the dare only if you and your team are happy with it.
It never owns part of the vault code. Skip it freely.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Beating Heart Stone, Chained Throne, Bone Altar.
